purpose: Teach: 北方/ケネディ/都立/近鉄/東急/Ｊリーグ/エンジニアリング/デスノート

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが北方領土のニュースをご覧になってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your father was watching the news about the Northern Territories.
lines.style: Warm, matter-of-fact delivery. Gently informing, the way she naturally shares what the household has been up to. Steady pace, no particular emphasis.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとケネディ家のドキュメンタリー観たよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad and I watched a documentary about the Kennedy family.
lines.style: Bright, eager to share. Quick tempo, the enthusiasm of a child reporting his day. Open, unguarded joy in the voice. Slight lift at the end.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが都立高校の同窓会に行かれたわ
lines.en: Sho — your father attended his high school alumni gathering.
lines.style: Calm, reflective tone. She's noticing something about his life, not surprised but thoughtful. Measured delivery, letting the information land softly.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと近鉄電車に乗ったよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad and I rode the Kintetsu train together.
lines.style: Eager, animated delivery. The simple joy of a shared small moment. Quick pacing, genuine warmth. Open vowels, easy breathing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが東急百貨店でプレゼントを買って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your father bought us a gift at the Tokyu department store.
lines.style: Slightly warm, quietly pleased. She's relaying something gentle and thoughtful. Even pacing, gentle emphasis on the kindness of the gesture.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとＪリーグの試合観たよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad and I went to watch a J-League match.
lines.style: Bright, energized delivery. The excitement of a shared experience coming through. Quicker tempo, open and genuine. Natural lift on the memory.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがエンジニアリング企業に転職されたわ
lines.en: Sho — your father changed jobs to an engineering company.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured delivery. She's processing something significant but not treating it as alarming. Steady tone, slight weight on the word 'changed'.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとデスノートの映画は子供向きじゃないって学んだよ
lines.en: Mom — Dad and I learned that Death Note isn't really a movie for kids.
lines.style: Gentle wryness underneath. A small, knowing smile in the voice. Conversational pace. Soft emphasis on the learning — not scolding, just the realization of it.
